title: Guardian of the Sands: Shogurei
summary: Disturbing the sacred sands brings servants and eventually Shogurei into the fight.
overview: Disturbing the sacred sands brings servants and eventually Shogurei into the fight.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Control servants as the garden activates and keep the group together for the guardian.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Sand trigger regions can call Stillmoon servants to defend the garden.
Task progression activates Shogurei for the confrontation.
During combat he can cast Denial of Flight on his target.

notes: Approval E317. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
